Breaking changes

SDK method memberBeforeAfter
Method kindbasiclro
Response typevoidMicrosoft.Chaos.ScenarioRun
Long-running behaviornone{"finalStateVia":"location","logicalResult":"Microsoft.Chaos.ScenarioRun","pollingStep":"model","finalStep":"finalOperationLink","statusMonitorStep":"nextOperationLink"}
Why this is breaking: The supplied TCGC facts show ScenarioConfigurations.execute changing from a basic method with no response type to an LRO returning ScenarioRun. Existing generated SDK calls therefore change invocation and result handling. ScenarioConfigurations.execute previously had no response type and now returns ScenarioRun through LRO completion, changing the generated public return contract. ScenarioConfigurations.execute gains Location-based polling metadata, a ScenarioRun logical result, and final-operation link steps where the prior basic method had none, changing generated poller behavior.

Model Location-based ARM LRO polling with native TypeSpec constructs

specification/chaos/resource-manager/Microsoft.Chaos/Chaos/scenarioRun.models.tsp
 import "./scenario.models.tsp";
 
 using TypeSpec.Rest;
+using TypeSpec.Http;
 using Azure.ResourceManager;
 using Azure.Core;
 using Azure.Core.Traits;
 
 namespace Microsoft.Chaos;
 
+/**
+ * Indicates the scenario run is still in progress. Clients polling via the
+ * Location header should continue polling until a 200 response is returned.
+ * The body reflects the current run state at the time of the poll.
+ */
+model ScenarioRunInProgressResponse {
+  ...AcceptedResponse;
+
+  /**
+   * The URL where the status of the long-running operation can be polled.
+   */
+  @header("Location")
+  location: url;
+
+  /**
+   * The number of seconds the client should wait before polling again.
+   */
+  @minValue(0)
+  @maxValue(2147483647)
+  @header("Retry-After")
+  retryAfter?: int32;
+
+  /**
+   * The current scenario run state at the time of the poll.
+   */
+  @bodyRoot body: ScenarioRun;
+}
+
 /**
  * Model that represents the scenario run.
  */
